gapReason.reason: The row is the deck's RAKE TASKS and its admin config - the six rake task files under mod/core/lib/tasks/ and config/admin.yml with the two locales. The port has no rake task runner: its equivalents are commands the deploy scripts invoke (the seed path at src/card/auth/boot-seed.ts) and the admin configuration is the port's own admin runtime (src/card/mod-loader/mods/core-admin-runtime.ts), which reads the deck's admin config by its own mechanism. The seventeen defs the port does not carry are the rake task CLI and its option parsing (add_opt, key_to_option_description, failing_loudly and the rest of card.rake's surface, plus the seed and migrate tasks' own methods), and the nine that measure SKIP are their private helpers.
